episodes.title: The Floating-Human-Body-Parts Capital of America
episodes.summary: When tourists on a fishing charter in Key West, Florida, discover a human arm, suspended detective Andrew Yancy takes the case.

episodes.title: A Hundred Bucks Says You Won't
episodes.summary: Caitlin meets with Yancy to discuss her suspicions about her stepmother Eve. Yancy learns of Eve's secret boyfriend.

episodes.title: Nobody Said He Was Alvin Einstein
episodes.summary: Yancy and Rosa continue their search for more information about Nick. Caitlin confronts Eve, leading to a shocking revelation.

episodes.title: Nothing's Wrong With It, I Just Don't Need It Anymore
episodes.summary: A flashback reveals Eve and Nick's origins, how Yancy got suspended, and Nick and Izzy's nefarious business dealings.

episodes.title: That Damn Arm Is Back
episodes.summary: Yancy makes a crucial realization as he goes into hiding. The Dragon Queen asks Egg about Neville.

episodes.title: Yo, Would You Tell Ms. Chase I Still Love Her Like Crazy
episodes.summary: In need of help, Yancy turns to Rogelio. Bonnie goes on the run. The Dragon Queen confronts Nick and Eve

episodes.title: A Total Cat Person
episodes.summary: Rogelio and Yancy find themselves in an explosive situation. Eve negotiates with the Dragon Queen.

episodes.title: The Russian Mob Is Very Active in Key West
episodes.summary: With Caitlin and Rosa's help, Yancy cooks up a new plan to get Nick and Eve back to Miami.

episodes.title: You Really Don't Want to Kill This Scrumptious Little Puppy
episodes.summary: Yancy learns that his plan has gone awry, leaving Rosa in danger. Eve and the Dragon Queen have a reckoning.

episodes.title: We're in the Memory-Making Business
episodes.summary: Season finale. The aftermath of the reckoning has shocking repercussions.
